Q-431-p1-BSR-MW-01-1.state_reason: Though the floor is FULL for 'without division,' Article II grounds that denial explicitly in Chalcedonian two-natures metaphysics ('two whole and perfect natures... joined together in one person'), a material commitment the Restoration comparator does not adopt, so agreement remains qualified rather than full.
Q-431-p1-BSR-MW-01-1.source_note: Article II of the Methodist Articles of Religion states the Godhead and Manhood were joined in one person, 'never to be divided,' affirming two complete natures united without separation.
Q-431-p1-BSR-MW-01-1.scope_caveat: The Articles of Religion and the EUB Confession are constitutionally protected standards of the United Methodist Church. The Global Methodist Church, which separated in 2022, holds the same Articles; its standards are cited here from its 2022 Transitional Book of Doctrines and Discipline, the only edition published on the church's own domain, and the Articles are unchanged in the 2024 edition. The Wesleyan Church holds its own articles, which the registry lists separately.

survivors.rationale: States Christ's two natures are perfectly and inseparably united, affirming the union without division of subjects.
survivors.chunk_text: We believe in Jesus Christ, truly God and truly man, in whom the divine and human natures are perfectly and inseparably united. He is the eternal Word made flesh, the only begotten Son of the Father, born of the Virgin Mary by the power of the Holy Spirit. As ministering Servant he lived, suffered and died on the cross. He was buried, rose from the dead and ascended into heaven to be with the Father, from whence he shall return. He is eternal Savior and Mediator, who intercedes for us, and by him all men will be judged.
